title: Multiscale cathode design for high-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6CS00242K, Review Article
Zhuo-Qi Shi, Liang Ding, Ze-Cheng Yao, Tang Tang, Rui Cao, Jin-Song Hu
This review highlights the multiscale cathode design for high-temperature proton exchange membrane fuel cells, bridging the gap from atomic-level catalyst design and interfacial engineering to device-level catalyst layer optimization.
